open_questions: Find has no door in P02. TD01 to TD09 carry a 44px glass search button beside the avatar (the old Sales hero had one). If it stays, it should be drawn in Main as a P02 variant.

TD01: with the P07 act row (Mukono · Take 1.1M, the Checking badge's job) and three Needs-you rows, the third row and the Next-move header run under the tab bar as scrolled content, the way the live agent Today does. Removing the hero's glass row would fit it, but the review wants the hero the same on every state.
Tell them sends from inside the app (through the shop's WhatsApp line) and queues the next customer. With wa.me only, each customer costs one more tap.
